segments.en: [This letter opens mid-sentence in the source text.]

…Who has merited to be a faithful servant to the true Tzadik — who reveals His G-dliness eye to eye to all who come into the world. And draws from the waters of his wisdom — to quench his thirst. And to water with them the souls of Israel — who roll about at the head of all the streets… who roll about in the streets — outside. And there is no one who gathers them into the house.

…And draws from the waters of his Torah — to quench the thirst of his soul. And his heart longs and burns like burning coals — to water with them the souls of Israel — who roll about in the streets outside. And there is no one who gathers them into the house. For the true Tzadik is the essential healing and salvation from all kinds of arrows and venomous poisons of the heresy and the false faiths…

…Who has merited to be a faithful servant to the Tzadik — who reveals His G-dliness eye to eye to all who come into the world. And draws from the waters of his wisdom — to quench the thirst of his soul — and to water with them the souls of Israel — who roll about outside. And there is no one who gathers them into the house. For the true Tzadik is… through whom is the essential healing and salvation, etc. Through whom His G-dliness is revealed… For the Torah of the Tzadik… For… And the Tzadik is…
